move.Talonflame: Weakest mon you own for these bosses. Gale Wings only works at full HP, and Arcanine covers Fire.
move.Furret: Its crest's Baton Pass trick doesn't hold up against 6-mon boss teams. Keep the crest in your bag.
move.Alakazam: Only knows Teleport, and you can't use the Move Relearner. Frail, and no Alakazite to make it worth fixing.
move.Amoonguss: Rage Powder is already covered by Leavanny-Aevian, with Tangrowth as backup.
move.Mismagius-Aevian: Low damage, and no crest or Mega to come.
move.Klinklang: Only one attacking type. Gholdengo is a far better Steel type.
move.Noivern: Hits too lightly. Dragalge and Leavanny-Aevian cover Dragon.
move.Lucario: The walkthrough has no Lucarionite through Chapter 8, and Gholdengo and Annihilape cover its types.
move.Toxicroak: Niche. Your Fighting types (Annihilape, Passimian, Hariyama) are all much stronger.
move.Kilowattrel: Light damage. Vikavolt is your Electric pick.
move.Electivire: Vikavolt is the better Electric type, and your Fighting types outclass its coverage.
move.Tentacruel: Utility only, and Gastrodon and Slowbro do its job better.
move.Blissey: New catch put straight into Active. Pure support (Soft-Boiled, Healing Wish) and almost no damage; scores D (0.25).

maybe.Runerigus: Once Golurk and Palossand are promoted, both are stronger Ground/Ghost types.
